mathematical_premises.scope: Any supported physical 3x3-minor law with constrained-side row marginals <=q/2, 1<=q<3/2; arbitrary same-bank curvature/outside conditioning; gives C0 density and explicit entropy-currency bound.
If E3>0 and no supported physical 3x3-minor law has every constrained-side row marginal strictly below 3/4, then ||p_Q||inf <=6*4^(1/6)E3^(-1/6), with C0 density in the theorem scope.

new_result.statement: For a physical cross block M with E3>0, set a_S=det(M_S M_S^T), tau_S=sum_{j notin S}dist(m_j,span M_S)^2, Z_gamma=4E4+gamma^2E3 and mu_gamma(S)=a_S(tau_S+gamma^2)/Z_gamma. Then sum a_S tau_S=4E4, mu_gamma is the exact convex interpolation of uniformly deleted E4 faces and canonical E3 sampling, and the lifted 3x3-minor entropy currency is G_gamma=Z_gamma exp[-E_mu log(tau_S+gamma^2)] >=(4E4+gamma^2E3)/(||M||_F^2+gamma^2). If max row marginal alpha_*<3/4, q=max(1,2alpha_*) gives ||p_Q||inf <=[3e/((3-2q)sqrt(q))]G_gamma^(-1/6), with p_Q in C0.

partner_result_actually_applied.actual_inequality: For the first four rows of the explicit dense rotated block, E3=2130 and strict all-row marginals <3/4 are impossible; hence ||p_Q||inf <=6*4^(1/6)*2130^(-1/6)=2.107485757711179...

explicit_rotated_example.spectral_check: R^T R-I has positive leading principal minors 19,639,13545,12290, so all four singular values exceed one; all physical cross entries are nonzero after the Householder right rotation.
